verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm chip/contactless card reader support, Tap to Pay on iPhone and Android contactless via SDK, and Apple Pay/Google Pay via Stripe's payment methods on Terminal-compatible readers/devices, plus real-world community validation of the API-based in-person integration. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of Apple Pay/Google Pay wallet taps on readers (evidence focuses more on contactless generally) and no dispute found.
